 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Mauricio Pochettino may be on his way out , but the U.S. men's national team still has unfinished business under the Argentine head coach.
 Pochettino will depart his role to take over Manchester United, but not until after the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal against Haiti.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The two-leg series begins at 4:30 p.m. ET on Saturday, Nov. 14 with Haiti's "home" leg in Miami. Though Haiti is unable to play in its own country, it should have a boisterous crowd behind it at Nu Stadium.
 Pochettino will likely put out a strong team in the first leg, with the USMNT looking to gain an advantage ahead of the second leg on Tuesday, Nov. 17 in Cincinnati.

(allanhenry, Allan Henry-Imagn Images) The Argentine won't have a full complement of players to choose from, with Sergiño Dest, Gio Reyna and George Campbell all withdrawing from the roster due to injuries.
 But he will still have plenty of talent to call upon, including Folarin Balogun, Christian Pulisic and Weston McKennie, all of whom missed the September-October international window.

 USMNT projected lineup vs Haiti
 Goalkeeper : Brian Schwake
 Defenders : Antonee Robinson, Auston Trusty, Chris Richards, Alex Freeman
 Midfielders : Tyler Adams, Weston McKennie, Malik Tillman
 Attackers : Christian Pulisic, Folarin Balogun, Cavan Sullivan
